content_sections.heading: CVRDE Paid Internship Vacancy 2026: Branch-Wise Details
content_sections.text: CVRDE is offering internships under two categories: Category (a) for UG engineering students and Category (b) for PG engineering students. The number of vacancies is indicative and may increase or decrease at the establishment's discretion. A total of 35 internship vacancies are available across both categories (15 under Category (a) and 20 under Category (b)).

content_sections.heading: CVRDE Paid Internship Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Regular students pursuing an Engineering Degree in B.E/B.Tech (7th/8th semester) or M.E/M.Tech (1st/2nd year) full-time course in the relevant discipline from a recognised Indian University/Institute. Only regular students from AICTE-approved technical institutions or UGC-approved universities are eligible to apply. Candidates should have a minimum 8.5 CGPA (on a 10-point scale) or 85% marks, maintained continuously in all previous semesters. Students with backlogs are not eligible. The scheme is open only to students holding Indian nationality. Students already receiving a stipend or similar benefit from any other institute are not eligible for this internship programme.

content_sections.heading: CVRDE Paid Internship Qualification
content_sections.text: Applicants must be regular full-time students of a recognised Indian University or Institute, currently pursuing B.E/B.Tech in the 7th or 8th semester (UG category) or M.E/M.Tech in the 1st or 2nd year (PG category), in one of the four disciplines listed above: Mechanical, Electronics/Electronics & Communication/Electronics & Instrumentation, Electrical, or Computer Science/AI/ML/IT. No equivalent qualification or related branch will be considered.

content_sections.heading: CVRDE Paid Internship Age Limit
content_sections.text: Below 28 years as on 1st July 2026. To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

content_sections.heading: CVRDE Paid Internship Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Selected interns will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 5,000/- for the six-month duration. The stipend is paid in two slabs of three months each, with Rs. 15,000/- credited directly to the student's bank account per slab. No boarding, lodging, or transport allowance is provided; students must make their own arrangements. A wet canteen facility is available at CVRDE for lunch and tea on a payment basis.

content_sections.heading: CVRDE Paid Internship Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is entirely on a merit basis, considering the candidate's academic track record (≥85% marks or ≥8.5 CGPA in every previous semester). Shortlisted students will be intimated through their registered e-mail ID along with joining instructions. Candidates who are not selected will not receive any communication. CVRDE/DRDO reserves the right to change the vacancy positions or selection criteria at any point during the selection process without assigning any reason.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for CVRDE Paid Internship 2026
content_sections.text: Duly filled application in the prescribed format (Appendix 'A') Request letter / No Objection Certificate from the Principal/Director of the institute (Appendix 'B') Duly filled Undertaking Form (Appendix 'C') Copies of all semester mark sheets (as applicable) Bonafide and Character Certificate issued by college authorities Copy of Aadhaar Card Copy of College ID card Student biodata (restricted to 300 words) Proof of awards/certificates, if any Proof of publications/patents, if any Recent passport-size photograph (4.5 x 3.5 cm)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CVRDE Paid Internship Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications for CVRDE Paid Internship 2026 are accepted only offline — there is no online application portal for this scheme. Candidates must send their application by Speed Post, Courier, or Registered Post to the address below, on or before 10 August 2026. Postal Address: The Director [Kind Attention: PC&HR Division] Combat Vehicles Research & Development Establishment (CVRDE) Ministry of Defence, Defence Research & Development Organisation (DRDO) Avadi, Chennai – 600054 Candidates should clearly mention "Application for Paid Internship" along with the relevant Branch Code Number on top of the envelope.

faq.question: Q1. What is CVRDE Paid Internship Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a six-month paid internship scheme announced by CVRDE, DRDO, for final-year Under Graduate and Post Graduate engineering students for the academic year 2026-27, offering 35 vacancies across Mechanical, Electronics, Electrical, and Computer Science/AI/ML/IT disciplines.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under CVRDE Paid Internship 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 35 vacancies are available - 15 under the UG category and 20 under the PG category - though the numbers are indicative and may change at CVRDE's discretion.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for CVRDE Paid Internship 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for CVRDE to receive applications is 10 August 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for CVRDE Paid Internship 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be regular students pursuing B.E/B.Tech (7th/8th semester) or M.E/M.Tech (1st/2nd year) in a recognised discipline from an AICTE-approved institution or UGC-approved university, with a minimum 8.5 CGPA or 85% marks throughout.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for CVRDE Paid Internship 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent offline via Speed Post, Courier, or Registered Post to CVRDE, Avadi, Chennai. There is no online application mode for this scheme.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for CVRDE Paid Internship 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is purely merit-based, using the candidate's academic track record. There is no written exam or interview mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the stipend for CVRDE Paid Internship 2026?
faq.answer: Selected interns receive Rs. 5,000/- per month for six months, paid in two instalments of Rs. 15,000/- each directly to their bank account.
